title: Productionize W12 edge-on paddle recovery (wrist-conditioned crop re-detect)

tsTracker: packages/swing-lab/src/paddleCropRecovery.ts: PADDLE_CROP_RECOVERY_VERSION='crop-recovery-v1'; CROP_RECOVERY_GATES = { cropScalesPx: [256, 704], scoreFloor: 0.08 (existing floor, unchanged), wristGateRadius: TRACKER_GATES.handAffinityRadius (0.13), fpMaxAspectRatio: 3.5, fpBelowWristMargin: 0.06, maxBridgeFrames: 2 }
Crop planning is wrist-conditioned on BOTH wrists at both scales (never trusts handedness; Apple Vision swaps L/R on rear views) and only for paddle-lost frames (paddleLostFrameTimes).
Detection-source provenance ('full_frame' | 'crop' | 'tracked_estimate') carried through buildPaddleTracks -> TrackedPaddleObservation -> selection.
Gating: crop-sourced candidates may EXTEND an existing track but NEVER seed a new track (appendObservation path skips unmatched crop candidates), so they cannot enter selection as raw detections.

FP-family suppression (measured W12 hard negatives: target shorts/leg + court line, ~0.53 conf): isFpFamily rejects extreme-aspect court-line slivers (aspect > 3.5) and boxes whose top edge sits >= 0.06 below every wrist.

Temporal propagation: bridgeTrackedEstimates inserts linearly interpolated observations tagged source='tracked_estimate' with detectorScore=0 for holes of <= 2 frames ONLY; 3+-frame holes are left as holes. Estimates are never presented as detections.

analyzeVideo.ts: --crop-recovery flag (off by default) plans crops, invokes detect_paddle.py --crops, admits/gates crop detections, rebuilds tracks, reruns selection, applies the bounded bridge, and labels the detector version as '<base>+crop-recovery-v1'.
pythonDetector: tools/paddle-lab/detect_paddle.py --crops <plan.json>: per-frame crop rectangles, absolute-CFR frame decode from t=0 (not -ss seek, per W12 timestampDiscovery), boxes mapped back to full-frame pixels, every detection tagged source='crop' + cropRect, cross-rect NMS union at IoU 0.55, existing 0.08 floor.

evidence.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck: all packages pass (including swing-lab).
evidence.tests: packages/swing-lab pnpm test: 12 files, 162 passed | 4 skipped. New test/paddleCropRecovery.test.ts (15 tests) covers: crop candidates cannot seed tracks (even at high score), crop candidates extend existing full-frame tracks with source preserved, 0.08-floor admission/rejection, far-from-wrist rejection, court-line aspect FP rejection, shorts/leg below-wrist FP rejection, in-hand paddle acceptance, 1-frame and 2-frame TRACKED_ESTIMATE bridges accepted, 3+-frame holes rejected, measured observations untouched, both-wrist/both-scale crop planning, merge provenance/immutability.

cpuCropModeDemo.device: cpu (Linux, torch 2.13.0+cpu, transformers 5.16.1, D-FINE medium COCO)
cpuCropModeDemo.plan: 3 frames (tMs 4600/5450/6250, chosen at annotated-visible paddle points), 2 rects each (256px + 704px squares) = 6 crops
cpuCropModeDemo.result: 3 frames, 6 crops processed, 129.6 ms/crop inference, wall 0.93 s (model load 0.43 s). 102 proxy-label detections returned, all tagged source='crop' + cropRect; per-frame max scores 0.9248 / 0.3654 / 0.8734.
cpuCropModeDemo.note: Crop centers came from the committed human annotation's paddle points, used only as demo crop centers (pose/wrists unavailable on Linux). This demonstrates the --crops plumbing, not the live wrist-conditioned recall.

honestNegatives: The live wrist-conditioned path is UNMEASURED here: Apple Vision pose extraction is macOS-only, canonical runs/ dirs are absent, and pnpm lab:regen cannot run on this Linux box. No cascade/recall/precision numbers are claimed for the production path.

FP-family suppression thresholds (aspect 3.5, below-wrist margin 0.06) encode the measured W12 failure geometry but were validated only at unit level, not against live crop detections on the dev case.
bridgeTrackedEstimates is applied to the selected lab candidate's observation list; the domain PaddleTrack remains measured-only, so estimates never enter downstream metrics as detections.

The raw crop demo (floor 0.08, pre-gating) returns many boxes/frame (30/29/43) — this is expected and is exactly why tracker-side admission gating exists; raw crop output is NOT usable without the gates.
blocked: End-to-end measurement of --crop-recovery on the dev case (afn-sasebo-rally2) requires macOS (Apple Vision pose) + canonical runs regeneration via pnpm lab:regen — must be done by the integrator on a macOS box.
Held-out cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) were not touched or iterated against.
